# Test plugins

Small plugins the testkit's plugin scenarios load as inputs (`tests/cpu/plugins.rs`).

- `xp-meter`: the XP Meter, the Lua twin of the compiled plugin in `../compiled-plugin`. A copy of
  the sample of that name, which lives with the Dereth project.
- `found-one`, `found-two`: plugins that do nothing, listed beside it as a fresh install finds them.
